entries.label: P text
entries.original: The coaching schedule and online material will be arranged between the Coach (Paul) and the Client (you). The Coach will recommend the frequency of coaching sessions based on assessment of the client’s requirements. Normally, the monthly coaching schedule includes 3 calls a month, minimum 30 minutes each. The 4th week may be a check-in through messaging or a phone call.
